Welcome aboard

One unforgettable northern voyage

Come along as we revisit our journey aboard Holland America's ms Volendam. Over 28 nights, our route takes us from Boston through Atlantic Canada, across to Iceland and Greenland, and back to the Canadian coast. This is our little home for cruise memories, port adventures, and the photos we love.
